name: state
meaning: TriggedStone state: 1 resting on the cliff (anim 1), 0 triggered (waiting TIMER ms), 2 rolling (anim 0; crushes once past crushTimeMs), 3 landed (anim 2, then back to 1). Byte stores 0x50236e/0x50247b, byte switch 0x50243f

name: timer
meaning: ms accumulated with g_dtMs in states 0 and 2, zeroed on each state change; compared unsigned (jbe 0x502476, 0x502501)

name: triggerDelayMs
meaning: PROPERTY TIMER (record +0x08): delay between the trigger and the roll

name: crushTimeMs
meaning: Anim_GetDurationMs(anim 0, all tracks) * 11 / 16 (0x50233a-0x502345): how far into the roll the stone reaches CRASHINGZONE; from then on every frame crushes what is inside

name: triggered
meaning: set by msg 0x1F when it starts the fall from state 1, cleared by msg 0x20 and Reset: a second 0x1F cannot re-trigger until the button is released

name: wolfOnButton
meaning: set when Ralph is in the msg 0x1F object list (0x502755); gates the scripted camera; cleared by msg 0x20 and Reset

name: crushZone
meaning: PROPERTY CRASHINGZONE (Scn_GetPropBox +0x00): the box whose objects are crushed (ObjGrid_QueryBoxPoints 0x502626)

name: camera
meaning: PROPERTY IDCAMERA (Scn_GetPropCamera +0x04): camera setup {u16 focal; u16 rot[3]; Vec3s pos} for Camera_StartScripted (0x5027cb-0x502845)
